name: ORBYX
description: ORBYX over A2A and MCP. Over A2A: the search visibility audit - how answer engines read a website, a score out of 100 and the list of things to fix. Over MCP, three rails: the portal (plans and prices, demo slots, booking), the analyzer, and the ORBYX Index of marketing tools with live pricing a site can embed. Open without an account; a token adds the account's tier and its own data.

skills.name: Audit a site for search visibility
skills.description: Checks the metadata files a crawler looks for, the robots policy, the structured-data graph and page health, then asks answer engines whether they mention the site. Over A2A: send the hostname to SendMessage, which returns a task that reaches TASK_STATE_COMPLETED in about a minute with the score as an artifact. Over MCP: audit_site returns a job id. Counts against the account's daily allowance.
examples: How do answer engines describe this website?

skills.name: Read a finished audit
skills.description: Returns progress while an audit is running, and the score out of 100 once it finishes, with the address of the full report. Over A2A this is the protocol itself - GetTask, ListTasks, or SubscribeToTask. Over MCP it is the get_audit tool, called with the job id.

skills.name: Check how crawlers read a site, free
skills.description: Over MCP only (tools/call crawl_check): crawler access by bot, the metadata files, the structured-data graph, a readability score and the fixes it names. No account.

skills.name: Find marketing tools for a job
skills.description: Over MCP only (the index rail): a job in prose → up to five tools from the ORBYX Index with the requirements each meets and its dated price history. No account.
examples: A newsletter tool under $50 a month
What does a typical landing-page builder cost?

skills.name: Find a business that confirmed its own facts
skills.description: Over MCP only (the directory rail): what a business does and where, in several languages, from businesses that verified their listing with ORBYX, each with its services and prices. Ordered by match and completeness. No account.
examples: A bakery near the old town that opens early
Un fontanero en Valencia con precios

skills.name: Book a demo with ORBYX
skills.description: Over MCP only (the portal rail): ORBYX plans with prices in the reader's currency, free demo times, and booking one for a named person with their consent. No account.
examples: Book a 30-minute ORBYX demo next Thursday

openIdConnectSecurityScheme.description: An unauthenticated call returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate pointing at the protected-resource metadata.
